title: Rust encode_rule255 reports profile-ceiling overflow as retryable-looking BufferTooSmall
description: Confirmed empirically (discovered-from project-LICHEN-worker6-xuc8, robustness pass). encode_rule255 (rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs:1415-1422) checks needed > single_frame_limit.min(SCHC_FRAG_MAX_PACKET_SIZE) before consulting out.len() and returns BufferTooSmall::new(needed, profile_limit). Probe: raw 22554-byte nonzero-TC packet -> BufferTooSmall{required:22555, provided:22554} regardless of actual out capacity, so a grow-and-retry caller loop never terminates. Python raises unambiguous SchcError 'Rule 255 raw IPv6 packet exceeds 22553 bytes' (python/src/lichen/schc/headers.py:146-147). Both fatal; only the error classification differs. Fix: return a terminal profile-limit SchcError::InvalidPacket (or dedicated variant) when needed exceeds the profile ceiling, reserving BufferTooSmall for genuinely too-small caller buffers.
